rows.text: calls `002D45C0(qword +0xD8, 1)`, sets bit 27 of dword `+0xE0` of the `+0xD8` object to (qword `+0xE0` non-null) and calls `002445C0()`; when `002C1A80(m, word 02F9736A, 0, word 02F97368, word 02F9736C)` (m = a 19-byte Save-layer helper applied to the signed word `+0xDE0` of the object qword `0209AC30` points to) is non-zero, calls `002D45C0(the +0xD8 object, 0)`, clears that bit 27, calls `002445C0()` and returns 0; otherwise, with A and B the signed 5-bit fields at bits 16-20 and 21-25 of dword `+0x180`, when A is above 1 and `02F97368 AND 0xCA0` is 0x400 or 0x80 with that bit set in `02F9736C` calls `00563EC0(rcx)` (only when B is positive or `02F9736A AND 0x480` is non-zero), or when it is 0x800 or 0x20 with that bit set calls `00564300(rcx)` (only when B is below A - 1 or `02F9736A AND 0x820` is non-zero); when B then differs it fills three words of the slot `rcx + 0xF0 + old B*8` from the `+0xD8` object's grid fields (the first via the 32-byte table at qword `+0xE0`, 0xFFFF when null), calls `002527B0(8, slot byte +7 + 0x20, slot word +0)`, `005655F0(rcx, new slot, 0)`, `005674B0(qword +0xC8, new slot)`, refreshes bit 27, calls `002445C0()` and `00249C60(10)` and returns 1; every other path calls `002D3900(qword +0xD8)` and returns 0
calls `00280120` with the incoming registers and returns its result when it is non-zero; otherwise pops two values with `00267E10(r9)` and returns `00560070(second value, first value)`
